# Govardhanan P — Full verified profile

Source: https://www.govardhanan.com (official first-party website). All facts below appear on the website.

## Summary
Govardhanan P is an MBA (General) student at the Faculty of Management Studies, Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, and a Mechanical Engineering graduate based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He is building a career in human resource management, supported by an HR internship at Textspeed Technology Pvt. Ltd. and HR certifications from the University of Minnesota, HRCI and Meta. His interests span human resources, digital marketing, business development and general management.

## Education
- 2025–2027: Master of Business Administration (MBA – General), pursuing — Faculty of Management Studies, Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, Chennai
- 2022–2025: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering — Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, Chennai — 68.47%
- 2019–2022: Diploma in Tool Engineering & Digital Manufacturing — NTTF, Vellore — CGPA 7.63
- 2018–2019: SSLC — Bharathi Matriculation Higher Secondary School, Maduravoyal, Chennai — 70.8%

## Experience
### HR Intern — Textspeed Technology Pvt. Ltd.
Exposure to recruitment and selection, support for talent acquisition, employee onboarding, attendance and leave management records, HR documentation, employee engagement activities and professional workplace communication.

### Operations Assistant — KGM Travels (family business), school transportation services, Chennai
Day-to-day operations, vehicle scheduling, route planning, parent communication about pickup and drop-off, fee collection and payment tracking, administrative records and resolving customer concerns.

## Projects
- Automatic Electromagnetic Braking System: contactless eddy-current braking using an electromagnet, mild-steel disc, ultrasonic sensor, relay module and Arduino microcontroller; modelled in AutoCAD and SolidWorks. Bench demonstration of automatic deceleration when an obstacle enters sensor range. Case study: https://www.govardhanan.com/projects/electromagnetic-braking
- MBA summer project: "A Study on Business and Digital Marketing Practices of Textspeed Technology Private Limited (A Website-Based Observational Study)" — sole student author.
